decision_question: May this sanitized version 0.6.0 be distributed as draftable source without claims of live host readiness or reliable performance?
acceptance_criteria: Distinct use case and scope relative to existing skills
Honest role, credential, offer and privacy boundaries
Material failure scenarios addressed in source
Foundry format validation and evidence provenance
No invented live host or unseen holdout results

limits: Reviewers and runners share a model family, provider, synthetic source author and parts of the source set.
The final safety reviewer had previously inspected earlier versions; others reviewed the current package.
No independent human, real host integration or protected unseen holdout was tested.

initial_reviews.finding: Historical 0.1 protocol reconstruction is disclosed; sampled records, hashes, mapping and prior evaluations match their available artifacts. No private details were found in reviewed files.

Role-to-practice overlaps on learning maps, but exact offer qualification, collection readback and safe monitoring make this a distinct companion. Assessment used origin/main d37fe62720e7b2bf3ab8ab0fe62e049750d95cd5.
Reviewed source addresses disclosed search privacy, interrupted outbox, event identity, conflicting observations and host-capability boundaries; no live reliability established.

disruptor.finding: Earlier versions could expose private eligibility in searches or scheduled alerts, lose changes on crashes, or duplicate alerts when checks overlap. Further review found conflicting observations and event identity hazards.
disruptor.resolution: Revised source requires authorized privacy boundaries, durable conditional baseline/event recording, serialized recovery or atomic transactions, and safe alert claims. Visible synthetic cases cover the identified failure modes. These are attempted falsifications, not proof.

claim_evidence_ledger.claim: The source gives distinct offer qualification and safe-save/watch instructions.
The package has a small synthetic matched response comparison.
claim_evidence_ledger.limits: One run per configuration on four visible development cases; baseline 7/13, treatment 12/13; one criterion failed in both; possible retained treatment context. No general uplift claim.

claim_evidence_ledger.claim: A host reliably schedules, tracks, and delivers alerts in production.
claim_evidence_ledger.smallest_next_test: Perform authorized host-specific implementation and recovery tests, including duplicate delivery, ambiguous send and conflicting observations.

claim_evidence_ledger.claim: The skill reliably improves outcomes across users and unseen tasks.
claim_evidence_ledger.smallest_next_test: Run a pre-registered, adequately sampled independent evaluation with protected unseen cases.

expiry: On any material skill, source, runtime, or claim change, or 2027-02-09, whichever is earlier.
required_follow_up: Retain test and review limitations in distribution.
Before claims of host operation, run authorized host-specific tests.
Before general outcome or uplift claims, evaluate with protected unseen cases.
Recheck the destination main branch and publish only the intended package.

negotiator.rationale: No source-only blocker remains, conditional on integrating against current main without deleting newer work and preserving evidence limits. The source is not evidence of a functioning monitor or live host.
negotiator.unresolved_observation: Treatment did not explicitly state that different B/C events from the same baseline can conflict or become stale.
limits: The event-key retry and overlap cases are specified but not individually executed in the 0.6.0 pilot.
Four author-visible cases, one sample per configuration, shared model family and possible prior runner context do not establish uplift.
Source review is not a host, security, delivery, eligibility, or production-readiness test.
